name: Raccoon Tycoon
summary: Commodity speculation and town-building auction game where players produce, sell, and use profits to buy buildings, towns and railroads.
rules_text: Players start with $10, 3 Price & Production cards, and escalating free commodities. Six commodity markets start at $1-$3. Each round in turn order each player does one action: 1) Production: play a card from hand, take up to 3 of the commodities shown (4 with Cottage Industry, 5 with Factory) plus at most one bonus building commodity, then raise market prices shown on the price area by $1 each, discard the card and draw to hand limit. Storage limit is 10 plus 1 per building. 2) Sell: sell any number of one commodity type at current market price, then lower that market price by number sold. 3) Railroad Auction: choose one of two face-up railroads, bid clockwise starting with initiator; highest bidder buys it, loser who started may still do another action. 4) Buy Building: pay its cost for its production or hand/storage bonus. 5) Buy Town: pay commodities listed on available town for its VP. Game ends when railroad or town deck empties; most VP from towns, railroads, buildings and money wins.
rating_reason: Commodity market and railroad auctions give bidding bluffing
